Turn on “Notification access” to forward phone notifications to your Mac

Running: mirroring needs no per-session approval and supports real touch

Connect your phone and Mac: notifications, clipboard, photos and files, screen mirroring.
This phone will stop forwarding notifications and syncing the clipboard with “%1$s”. You’ll need to scan a QR code to connect again.
Notifications and call alerts on your Mac
Pick the apps to forward and new notifications show up on your Mac. Incoming calls alert you there too.
Copy text on your phone and paste it on your Mac, or the other way around.
Mirror your screen, browse your files
Control your phone from your Mac and browse its photos and files, saving with a simple drag.
On. Phone copies sync when you return to this app
Turns on when connected to Mac
Choose the apps to forward. Their new notifications appear on your Mac.
Copy text on one device and paste it on the other.
Only text copied after connecting is shared
The mirroring service is running, so text copied in the background reaches your Mac right away
Android doesn’t let apps read the clipboard in the background. Text copied on the phone reaches your Mac when you return to this app. Start the mirroring service for real-time sync.
Content that password managers mark as sensitive is never sent. Transfers use an encrypted direct connection, with no server in between.
Lets your Mac mirror and control this phone without per-session approval, and syncs the clipboard in real time.

1. Connect the phone to your Mac with a USB cable 2. Allow “USB debugging” on the phone 3. On the Mac’s Mirroring page, start the enhanced service After that you can unplug; it keeps running until the phone restarts.
Includes: screen mirroring with real touch, independent display, audio forwarding, Mac microphone, and real-time clipboard sync.
Silence the phone while it’s connected to your Mac, and restore it when you disconnect.
Your Mac shows an alert and rings for incoming calls. Adjust this in the Mac’s Settings.
One UI aggressively stops background apps. Follow these steps to keep the connection stable.
